findings.text: follow-on: the discovery call 2 and warm wall times are written as 30.054 s and 30.046 s, the roadmap rows copied across, while the raw records give 28.92 s and 20.647 s (results/read-plan-discovery-default.json) and the report's own prose says 20.65 s (report.md:61,114); the claim's key row is misstated and its answered verdict carries a wall beyond the 30 s deadline it answered inside.

follow-on: logs/summary-table.md, cited as the rendered table, omits the read-plan-discovery-default, fixture-control-repeat and fixture-missing-plan runs the report leans on, so the rendered table is not a rendering of the results directory.

follow-on: the done_when's positive-control clause (a three-plan fixture answers in under a second) is unmet on this node at 2.03 s, reproduced at 2.046 s and 2.039 s at load 13.8, and the node localised it to a fixed ~2 s success-path wait rather than retuning the bound; the clause is a repair candidate for the read path, not a defect this node could repair.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base ad0b0b611; the run made no repository change and the worktree is clean, so the diff is empty and the deliverable is the out-of-tree report directory named in changed_paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for cold and warm wall and CPU for all three reads, the functions dominating the slowest, the deadline verdict, and a sub-second three-plan positive control; report.md gives the first three (lines 29-66) and records the control failing its bound (report.md:129-152).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to measure cold and warm wall and CPU seconds for read_plan, roadmap and crew as a reckon MCP server answers them on the fleet node; report.md:29-49 gives all three reads at cold/call 2/warm with their per-call load on node 98dci4-clu-2002.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete with the gate command and its result, the top cumulative functions, the claim comparison and the unmet control; its commits field records that no repository work landed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's one declared write path is its report directory; report.md, drive_mcp_read.py, profile_mcp_server.py, build_fixture.py, results/ and logs/ all sit inside it, and git status in the worktree is empty.

justifications.durability: no repository file changed so there is no regression to guard; the node ships a reproducible driver (report.md:199-210) and raw records under results/, the only durable evidence a measurement can carry.
justifications.evidence: the gate ran drive_mcp_read.py and its per-call figures are recorded in results/*.json, but report.md:38-39 misstates two wall times and logs/summary-table.md omits three runs the report relies on.
justifications.fit: the report follows the plan's documentation idiom and the scripts are named by mechanism (drive_mcp_read.py, build_fixture.py), touching no repository source and introducing no forbidden name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: report.md:31-49 gives cold, call 2 and warm wall and CPU seconds for read_plan summary, roadmap summary, crew live and read_plan discovery, each with its per-call 1-minute load.
justifications.reuse: the run added no repository definition; its harness scripts live outside every checkout (manifest changed_paths) and fork no capability the repository owns.
